_about: reserved-slots.toml, read by the Pterodactyl egg's reclaimer-reserved-slots.py (not by Project Reclaimer itself). The egg's Reserved … variables override these keys when they aren't empty. Types follow src/renderer/lib/settings-form.js.

fields.label: Reserved slots
fields.help: Slots only whitelisted players may take, out of the first server's max players. 0 turns reserved slots off.

fields.label: Reserved password
fields.help: Join password the server gets while its public slots are full. Give it to whitelisted players. No spaces.

fields.label: Whitelist
fields.help: Players who may use reserved slots. Admins always may. Players find their ID under Settings → Connectivity → Your player ID.

fields.label: Bump to make room
fields.help: When the server is completely full and a whitelisted player is refused, kick one player who isn't whitelisted so they can join.

fields.label: Bump order
fields.help: Who is bumped first, first rule first: lowest_score (in the game being played), least_session_time (this visit), least_total_time (all visits). Ties go to the newest player.
